subject: Energy
title: Energy Consumption by Sector
description: A fast breakdown of Energy Consumption by Sector for builders.

hook.text: Global energy splits roughly into thirds—industry, transport, and buildings (heating, cooling, appliances).

buildup.text: Industry is the largest sector—steel, cement, chemicals, and manufacturing consume about 37% of total energy.

discovery.text: Transport consumes about 26%—dominated by oil for cars, trucks, ships, and planes moving people and goods.

twist.text: Buildings use about 31%—mostly for heating, cooling, and hot water, with substantial waste from poor insulation.

climax.text: Electricity carries only 20% of total energy—the rest is direct heat and fuel, making electrification a huge challenge.

punchline.text: Three sectors, one problem—decarbonize them all.

quiz.question: What percentage of global energy does electricity currently carry?
